message: ## What does this PR do? This PR integrates `react-scan` into the application, providing a performance debugging overlay that can be activated and deactivated by users with `@langfuse.com` email addresses via a new toggle in the user avatar menu. The state of `react-scan` is persisted in `localStorage`, and the library is dynamically imported only when enabled, ensuring no impact on bundle size or performance for other users.
